title: Warranty Claim on a Unit Bought Before the Term Was Extended
scenario_text:
Auriga Devices sells hardware with a standard warranty defined in its Warranty Policy.

Version 1 (applies to units purchased through 2024-04-30): "The standard warranty is 12 months from the purchase (invoice) date, covering parts and labor."

Version 2 (effective 2024-05-01): "The standard warranty is 24 months from the purchase (invoice) date, covering parts and labor." v2 includes a transition clause: "The warranty term is fixed at the unit's purchase (invoice) date and runs from that date. Units purchased on or before April 30, 2024 carry the v1 12-month term; units purchased on or after May 1, 2024 carry the v2 24-month term. The extended term does not apply retroactively to units purchased before May 1, 2024."

The order/warranty system shows unit SN-91002 (customer: Trellis Design Studio): Invoice Date 2024-03-18, Product: workstation dock, Warranty Claim opened 2025-06-05 for a failed power module.

A warranty operations agent posts in #warranty-claims on 2025-06-06: "SN-91002 claim came in June 5 for a dead power module. Invoice was March 2024. The customer says everything now ships with a 2-year warranty, so they're covered. Are they in warranty or not?"

Using the policy history, the transition clause, and the warranty record, determine whether the claim on SN-91002 is within warranty.
question: Is the warranty claim on SN-91002 within warranty?
choices: The claim is out of warranty. The unit was purchased 2024-03-18, before May 1, 2024, so the v1 12-month term applies and expired 2025-03-18; the claim filed 2025-06-05 falls outside it, and v2's 24-month term does not apply retroactively.
The claim is covered, because v2's 24-month warranty (effective May 1, 2024) applies to all units and does not expire until 2026-03-18.
The claim is covered, because the 24-month term runs from the v2 effective date of 2024-05-01, expiring 2026-05-01.
The claim is covered, because warranty coverage is determined by the claim date, and v2 is the policy in force on 2025-06-05.
